system.text:
Warlords quickly grow to understand that the world sees Trolls as mindless brutes, good only for absorbing and dealing devastation. Outsiders forget that Trolls can evince intelligence. Troll Warlords use this prejudice to their advantage—playing the part of the dumb automaton while scheming and plotting behind their thick masks. Call-on for Strategy and Tactics when unveiling a surprising stratagem or ploy.

Type: C-O. Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Troll lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 533
